title: exportPdf
description: Backend RPC action: exports the ordered selection as vector PDF or flattened JPG pages. Streams pdf-progress events to the UI and returns page payloads for client-side PDF assembly (pdf-lib).

mode.description: 'vector' exports PDF bytes; 'flatten' exports JPG at scale 1.

merge.description: Hint for the UI: true = single multi-page PDF, false = one file per frame.

order.description: Node ids in the desired page order (from the drag-and-drop SelectionList).

returns.description: Resolves to { ok: true, pages[{name,bytes,isImage,format,width,height}], merge, pageName } or { ok: false, error }.
